design_note: All arms receive the same per-case documents and total character budget. The baseline reads the complete source pool; selector methods can read a subset. Human-authored source signals make the diagnostic proxy non-blind. No model or held-out evaluation.

cases.name: Local current trace
cases.purpose: A local selector should save reading chars without losing local counterevidence.

cases.name: Linked cross-sector contradiction
cases.purpose: Expanding from worker to queue to API should recover cross-sector evidence.

cases.name: Missing dependency counterexample
cases.purpose: With missing links the selective methods miss a decisive API source; full corpus must retain it.

cases.name: Deep evidence beyond fixed expansion
cases.purpose: Focused dependency expansion may suggest the right diagnosis but omit the deep decisive trace.
